items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, preserve private and parked gates, and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix only; do not create duplicate work, access credentials or private containers, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Preserve private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases.
